event: Nala lies still in the dark and listens to the low voices beyond the walls.
She sorts them: two or three deep voices, and one close above her that hums as it talks.
They talk low and quick; the rise and fall carries, but the sounds smear like talk underwater.
She strains for any piece she knows; nothing in the rhythm sounds like English at all.
Her window opens on a new Path: Path of Eavesdropping.
She pushes harder, spreading her soul out to the body's edges to press closer to the voices.
Her whole small body jerks with the effort, and a heel drives hard into the wall of the womb.
The humming voice gasps; the talk beyond the walls stops dead. She has caught no whole word.
A hand presses flat on the outside, right over her, then a second, heavier hand beside it.
A deep voice murmurs close against the wall, slow; the hands stay, pressing, waiting.
